desc: Parse N and A from stdin safely as a concatenated binary string of length 3^N.
Implement the iterative bottom-up two-state DP level by level: each node stores dp0 = min flips to force value 0 and dp1 = min flips to force value 1.
For each parent, compute dp_t = sum of the two smallest child dp_t values over its three children, for t in {0,1}.
Compute the original root value and print dp[1 - original_root].
Validate against samples, including sample 1 (answer 1) and sample 2 (answer 2).
Confirm O(3^N) time and acceptable memory for N up to 13.
